commands.name: progress-tracker
commands.description: Check the cpm-next progress trackers against the epic docs, name a spec ("01") to prepare its tracker, "times" for how long stories take, "all" for every project's progress in a pane, or "all publish" for it as a claude.ai page
commands.output: No docs/specifications or docs/cpm/specifications folder in this directory or above it.

tools.name: publish_tracker
tools.description: Prepares the cpm-next progress tracker for a spec: the claude.ai page that shows the build order and status of its epics and stories. Call this when asked to make, publish or share a progress tracker or progress page for planned work, and never write such a page by hand. It writes the page from the plugin's template and answers with how to publish it; the rows are then kept in step with the epic docs.

tools.name: story_times
tools.description: How long this project's cpm-next stories have taken, measured from the epic docs, and how long each story in progress has run, with the time left where the timings are steady enough to predict it. Call this when asked how long a story, an epic or the remaining work will take or has taken, and answer from it rather than estimating from the steps left.

children: No trackers indexed yet. Run /progress-tracker in a project to add its trackers.
